append.detail: 2026-10-27 (SCAN-1129 thread): second slice. New kit helpers chipClasses (components/ui/chip.tsx, the kit .chip/.chip.on) and choiceTileClasses (components/ui/choice-tile.tsx). Selected-state toggles (creator tabs, Near me, mobile editor tabs, billing toggle, visibility, practice builder, spaces toolbar), selectable tiles (event draft, RSVP, on-air, connection prefs, email opt-in, member viewer) and soft/ghost/state-driven actions (publish buttons, claim and join buttons, store, complete) moved onto the kit. Left: admin files, global-error, the Airwaves play button, circle-location-search (its probe mocks module deps), and quirk hits where the ratchet's proximity window catches a comment. Standard-action residual pass: training Complete and QR print action now share buttonClasses, and print layout anchor choices share chipClasses while retaining query URLs. Non-class JSX/logic AST comparison preserves handlers, pending/disabled state, labels and anchors. ShowEpisodes was inspected and retained as a 44px circular pressed Play/Close affordance. No full rendered or aggregate completion claim.
